definitions.explanation: Not formal or serious; relaxed in manner.
Used to encourage someone to do something without formality or worry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}でも→何でも：00304_nandemo⟧{気軽|きがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：02089_soudan⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please feel free to consult me about anything.

examples.japanese: {気軽|きがる}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{越|こ}し→越す：02282_kosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{気軽|きがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I want a friend I can talk to casually.

examples.japanese: {気軽|きがる}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I like cafes with a casual atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、{気軽|きがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you have any trouble, please don't hesitate to speak up.

examples.japanese: {気軽|きがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企画|きかく}した→企画する：04879_kikaku⟧。
examples.english: I planned an event that anyone can easily participate in.

notes:
FORMS:
- {気軽|きがる}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun (adnominal)
- {気軽|きがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial) - "feel free to"
- {気軽|きがる}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (predicative)
⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit, feeling) + ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ (light)

USAGE:
Often used to encourage others to do something without hesitation:
- {気軽|きがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧ (feel free)
- {気軽|きがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please don't hesitate to speak to me)
- {気軽|きがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (easy to participate in)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{堅苦|かたくる}しい→堅苦しい：25258_katakurushii⟧ - stiff, formal
